user.title: Tank
user.description: Name the tank and give its volume and temperature sensor.

data_description.volume: The effective volume of the tank, 20-2000 L.
data_description.tank_sensor: The temperature sensor of the tank.
data_description.sensor_height: Where the sensor sits in the tank, as a percentage of the tank height from the bottom (20-80). The data sheet of the tank gives it.

water_meter.title: Water meter
water_meter.description: Choose the total water meter of the house.

data_description.water_meter: The total water meter of the house, with a volume unit (L, m3, gal or ft3). It counts the hot and the cold water.

heat.title: Heat input
heat.description: Give at least one way to know when and how much the tank is heated. The flow and return temperatures give the charged temperature.

data_description.energy_counter: The thermal energy counter of the heater for heating the tank, in kWh.
data_description.power_sensor: The heat power of the heater for heating the tank, in W.
data_description.heating_active: A binary sensor that is on while the tank is being heated.
data_description.flow_sensor: The flow temperature of the heater. Give it together with the return temperature.
data_description.return_sensor: The return temperature of the heater. Give it together with the flow temperature.

detection.title: Shower detection
detection.description: Choose bathroom humidity sensors, if you have them.

data_description.humidity_sensors: A rise in humidity tells a shower or bath from other draws. Leave empty to detect showers by the long draw duration only.

cold.title: Cold water
cold.description: Choose a cold water temperature sensor, if you have one.

data_description.cold_sensor: The temperature of the cold supply water. Leave empty to use the seasonal curve of the options.

error.water_meter_unit: The water meter must have a volume unit: L, m3, gal or ft3.
error.no_heat_source: Give at least one of the energy counter, the heat power sensor and the heating active binary sensor.
error.flow_return_pair: Give both the flow and the return temperature sensor, or neither.

abort.already_configured: A tank with this temperature sensor is already set up.

init.title: Tank and temperatures
init.description: The tank, and the temperature and shape values of the model.

data_description.volume: The effective volume of the tank, 20-2000 L.
data_description.tank_sensor: The temperature sensor of the tank.
data_description.sensor_height: Where the sensor sits in the tank, as a percentage of the tank height from the bottom (20-80). The data sheet of the tank gives it.
data_description.thermocline_width: The width of the layer between hot and cold water, as a percentage of the tank. Learned from the first sensor drop after each charge.
data_description.usable_fraction: The fraction of the tank that can be drawn before the outlet runs cold, 0.5-0.98. The Shower ran cold button learns it.
data_description.mix_temperature: The temperature of your shower water.
data_description.max_temperature: The highest temperature the model accepts for the tank.
data_description.sensor_tolerance: How far below the charged temperature the tank sensor may read before the cold layer is taken to have reached it.
data_description.sensor_margin: How far the tank average may stay above the value the tank sensor gives.
data_description.ambient_temperature: The temperature around the tank, for the standing loss.
data_description.cold_mean: The yearly mean of the cold water temperature, used without a cold water sensor.
data_description.cold_amplitude: The seasonal swing of the cold water temperature around its mean.
data_description.cold_coldest_day: The day of the year (1-365) on which the cold water is coldest.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: The water meter and the optional sources.

data_description.water_meter: The total water meter of the house, with a volume unit (L, m3, gal or ft3). It counts the hot and the cold water.
data_description.energy_counter: The thermal energy counter of the heater for heating the tank, in kWh.
data_description.power_sensor: The heat power of the heater for heating the tank, in W.
data_description.heating_active: A binary sensor that is on while the tank is being heated.
data_description.flow_sensor: The flow temperature of the heater. Give it together with the return temperature.
data_description.return_sensor: The return temperature of the heater. Give it together with the flow temperature.
data_description.humidity_sensors: A rise in humidity tells a shower or bath from other draws. Leave empty to detect showers by the long draw duration only.
data_description.cold_sensor: The temperature of the cold supply water. Leave empty to use the seasonal curve of the options.

draws.title: Draws, losses and heat
draws.description: The values for draws, standing loss and heat input. Learned values replace them unless locked.

data_description.loss_coefficient: The standing loss, as a fraction per hour of the excess of the tank over the ambient temperature. Learned from quiet nights and charges.
data_description.other_hot_share: The share of the litres drawn outside a shower that comes from the tank. Learned from charges.
data_description.startup_energy: The energy of each heating run that does not reach the tank. Learned from charges.
data_description.shower_flow: The flow of a shower, to turn litres into minutes.
data_description.humidity_rise: The rise in bathroom humidity, in percentage points above the lowest value of the window, that counts as a shower.
data_description.humidity_window: The window over which the lowest humidity is taken.
data_description.long_draw_minutes: A draw that lasts this long counts as a shower. 0 turns the rule off.
data_description.reclassify_window: The litres drawn this long before a shower is detected count as shower water.
data_description.session_gap: Draws less than this far apart belong to one session.
data_description.max_draw: A rise of the water meter above this in one reading is ignored as a meter catching up.
data_description.power_threshold: The heat power above which the heater counts as heating the tank.

learning.title: Learning
learning.description: Lock learned parameters and set the history for the setup fit.

data.history_days: Days of history for the setup fit

data_description.locks: A locked parameter keeps its value from these options and is never learned.
data_description.history_days: How many days of recorder history the setup fit and the recalibrate action replay, 1-30.

error.water_meter_unit: The water meter must have a volume unit: L, m3, gal or ft3.
error.no_heat_source: Give at least one of the energy counter, the heat power sensor and the heating active binary sensor.
error.flow_return_pair: Give both the flow and the return temperature sensor, or neither.

set_tank_state.name: Set tank state
set_tank_state.description: Sets the tank average and the charged temperature by hand. With neither given, the tank is charged to the reading of the tank sensor.

tank_average.name: Tank average
tank_average.description: The new tank average temperature. The charged temperature stays as it is.

charged_temperature.name: Charged temperature
charged_temperature.description: The new charged temperature of the hot layer.

recalibrate.name: Recalibrate
recalibrate.description: Fits the parameters of the tank again from the recorder history. Locked parameters and the usable fraction learned from the button stay.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days of history to replay, 1-30. The default is the number in the options.

no_tank_targeted.message: The action targets no loaded tank.

tank_sensor_unavailable.message: The tank sensor is unavailable, so the tank cannot be charged to its reading. Give the temperatures.

no_history.message: There is no recorder history to fit.
